title: Puharich's journal lists the names of the space kids

tellings.quote: actually in fact, in one of his journals he like wrote all the names of the kids at the time.

plain: In one of his journals, Andrija Puharich, a doctor who studied psychic abilities, is said to have written down the names of all the children, known as the "space kids", that he was working with in the 1970s. An unnamed researcher says this in a 2026 episode with Michels about Puharich, telling it as something found in his own papers. It would mean the group of children was real and recorded at the time, not just remembered later.
